name: Do I need water leak detection if I only see a small damp spot?

mainEntity.name: Do I need water leak detection if I only see a small damp spot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even a small damp spot can indicate a larger, hidden problem. What appears as minor surface moisture could be the visible symptom of a significant leak behind a wall, under a floor, or in a ceiling. Ignoring it can lead to structural damage, mold growth, and higher water bills over time. Early investigation, even for small signs, is crucial to prevent the issue from escalating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a small damp spot can signal a larger, hidden leak that needs professional investigation to prevent further damage.
